subject.title: feat: add tools.fs.roots — per-agent filesystem roots with access modes

question: Should OpenClaw accept `tools.fs.roots` as the canonical granular host filesystem/media access contract, with sandbox behavior and exec enforcement explicitly out of scope for this PR?
rationale: The remaining source bug is mechanically fixable, but accepting a new config and Plugin SDK filesystem policy surface is a maintainer product/security-boundary decision.

options.title: Accept after root-widening repair
options.body: Land the feature only after explicit configured roots remain the single source of truth and focused upgrade/security tests pass.

options.title: Narrow to media-only follow-up
options.body: Pause this broad PR and ask for a smaller media-root contract if maintainers do not want one shared filesystem policy surface yet.

options.title: Close in favor of a broader design
options.body: Close or supersede the PR if maintainers want filesystem roots, exec, sandbox, and media policy redesigned together before any config surface ships.

recommendation.title: Accept after root-widening repair
recommendation.body: Land the feature only after explicit configured roots remain the single source of truth and focused upgrade/security tests pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The central outbound media access path and Plugin SDK media helper are the highest-impact owner boundary for the current blocker and product decision.
